headline: Ostley Marine reviews future of Brackwater yard
body: Ostley Marine Services is reviewing the future of its Brackwater repair yard after a fall in orders, the company told staff on Monday. No decision has been made, and the yard will keep working through the winter.

headline: Pellridge says October supplier invoices were paid on time
body: Pellridge Foods said on Tuesday that all of its October supplier invoices were paid on time, after a post on a trade forum claimed that packaging suppliers had not been paid. The company said the post was wrong and that it had asked the forum to remove it.
